title: Item 16b · Icon housekeeping: tooltips, Forms' Sent tick, the icon map
subtitle: Approved in each section, plus drift. Three loose ends of the icon rules. Tooltips: every icon-only button needs a tooltip with the same words as its label (§1.4, §4). Camps, Finance and the testing sections use the shared button (28px, 16px icon, tooltip); Calendar, Schedule, Prospects and Forms use a plain 44px button with a 20px icon and no tooltip — 13 buttons (the Schedule build plan said to reuse the shared one). Forms' Sent screen shows a 40px tick, over the 24px limit (§2.2). The map: §2.4 puts an icon in the map before it is used; 8 icons in use have no row — 7 were approved in their sections (Hide private details' row was planned at the Finance merge and missed) and Forms' camera was never decided. Already settled: 12b's door icons, 16a's pencil and user-off; 15a turns Forms' and Finance's back arrows into links. (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data; icon boards drawn from the app's own Tabler set)

items.caption: 1. Calendar: plain 44px buttons with 20px icons and no tooltip. The same in Schedule (⋯), Prospects (⋯, the panel's ✕), Forms (a field's ⋯, remove ✕) and the Edit statuses / Event types rows.
2. How the other sections do it (Color Belt here; Star, Black Belt, Camps and Finance the same): a 28px button, a 16px icon, and on the PC a dark tooltip with the words a screen reader hears.
3. After a form is sent: staff see a 40px tick; families see a 24px tick in a pale-green circle.
4. Eight icons in use with no row in the icon map.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · all three

7. Eight new rows in the icon map, written with the other rulebook rows at the end of the walkthrough.

columns.note: What changes where: new students — Calendar, Schedule, Prospects and Forms use the shared IconButton for their 13 icon-only buttons (a tooltip, a 16px icon); Forms' Sent screen uses the family page's tick. Main — the 8 map rows. Picture 5 is drawn over the real Calendar; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question: tidy up the icon rules?
A · Keep as today. + no work. − four sections keep buttons with no tooltip, so on the PC you have to guess what ⋯ or ‹ does; 8 icons stay outside the map, so the next section can't see they are taken; Forms' tick stays over the size limit.
B · Recommended: all three (pictures 5–7). + every icon-only button shows its name on the PC and has the same size everywhere; Forms' Sent screen matches the family page; every icon is in the map. − 13 button swaps in the new-students area, one icon change in Forms, 8 map rows.
C · Only the paperwork: the 8 map rows; the buttons and the Sent tick stay. + no app work. − the tooltip rule (§1.4) stays broken in four sections.
